occurrences.quote: Who is the director and producer of "We, the Normal"?

The claim cannot be verified. While "We, the Normal" (1987) is identified as a video by George Kuchar, the passages do not provide George Kuchar's birth date. Arthur Penn was born September 27, 1922, but without Kuchar's birth date, a comparison cannot be made to determine if Penn was born before him.
